title: Survey - what problems do AI game devs run into? ($25 gift card)
author: jamesylvania
selftext:
I'm a former AAA game dev now focused on building solutions for game developers. I'm doing some discovery work on what problems game devs, especially those using AI, run into. 

I'm looking for folks to take a quick survey, as well as for people who are interested in participating in a short 30-minute interview to dive deeper into the challenges you face (you can opt in at the end of the survey). 

[https://forms.gle/DJmGCvXQ3evrcog68](https://forms.gle/DJmGCvXQ3evrcog68) 

(This is my first post here, so let me know if this post belongs somewhere else!)

comments.author: Initial_Spend8988
comments.body: why didnt the gg! Newsletter work? what failed? what could you have done better?

replies.author: jamesylvania
replies.body:
Hey thanks for asking! gg! was an attempt at making a TLDR-style newsletter for the game industry. Technically it worked pretty well (I thought it was a really good mix of automation and human curation), but I never really got traction on it. I think if I reboot the newsletter I need to do more discovery to understand better what problems developers solve when they sign up for a game dev newsletter, so that the product I offer engages them more.

  
Also, I hated waking up several times a week and having to approve new stories about more layoffs in the industry. I think in my \~6 months of running the newsletter, I covered more than 10,000 devs being fired.
